<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="PART_I"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">PART</span><span style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> I</span></p>
<div style="align:left;">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:8.4%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:5pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Item 1.</span></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:5pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;" id="ITEM_1_BUSINESS">BUSINESS</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:5pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Company Overview</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Antares Pharma, Inc. (&#8220;Antares,&#8221; &#8220;we,&#8221; &#8220;our,&#8221; &#8220;us&#8221; or the &#8220;Company&#8221;) is a specialty pharmaceutical company focused primarily on the development and commercialization of pharmaceutical products and technologies that address unmet needs in targeted therapeutic areas. We develop, manufacture and commercialize, for ourselves or with partners, novel therapeutic products using our advanced drug delivery systems that are designed to provide commercial or functional advantages such as improved safety and efficacy, reduced side effects, convenience, and enhanced patient comfort and adherence. We also seek product opportunities that complement and leverage our commercial platform. We have a portfolio of proprietary and partnered commercial products and ongoing product development programs in various stages of development. We have formed significant strategic alliances and partnership arrangements with industry leading pharmaceutical companies including Pfizer, Idorsia, Teva and AMAG. Our FDA-approved products include XYOSTED<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (testosterone enanthate) injection, OTREXUP<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (methotrexate) injection, NOCDURNA<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (desmopressin acetate), which is licensed from Ferring Pharmaceuticals, and Sumatriptan Injection USP, which is distributed by Teva. We are also the exclusive supplier of devices to Teva for their Epinephrine Injection USP, the generic equivalent of <span style="color:#000000;">EpiPen<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>and EpiPen<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Jr., the devices for Teva&#8217;s generic teriparatide injection product, and of the Makena<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> subcutaneous auto injectors to AMAG.</span></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2020 Highlights and Areas of Focus</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We achieved several significant operating and financial milestones in 2020:</p>

We generated record pre-tax income of $9.9 million and recognized an income tax benefit of $46.3 million, resulting in net income and basic earnings per share of $56.2 million and $0.34, respectively, for the year ended December&#160;31, 2020 as compared to a net loss and net loss per share of $2.0 million and $0.01, respectively, for the year ended December&#160;31, 2019. Earnings per share on a fully diluted basis was $0.33 for the year ended December 31, 2020.</span></p></td></tr></table></div>

XYOSTED<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> is the only FDA approved subcutaneous testosterone enanthate product for once-weekly, at-home self-administration of testosterone replacement therapy.</span></p></td></tr></table></div>

We have implemented safety measures and protocols to protect the health and safety of our employees and comply with governmental and public health guidelines while working to ensure the sustainability of our business operations and continuity of supply. We shifted to a primarily remote work environment for our corporate and administrative functions and limited the number of staff in our facilities to those necessary for essential functions such as research, development, manufacturing and supply. Our sales force has been subject to varying limitations on their ability to physically visit&#160;physicians, and in response we strategically shifted to a virtual detailing platform and continued to utilize our social media presence to connect with our existing and potential customers and healthcare professionals.&#160;While our field-based team has now resumed in-person interaction with fewer restrictions, we believe we are also well-positioned with our virtual capabilities to continue to engage healthcare professionals and patients through the ongoing Pandemic and beyond. </span></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In addition to these significant achievements and areas of focus in 2020, we continued to devote resources and advance our internal research and development programs to further expand our product pipeline. We also made significant progress on partnered development projects with our partners Pfizer and Idorsia, made investments in capital improvements and infrastructure, and maintained a disciplined approach to growth and operating expenditures to support our continued and future growth.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:5pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The following table provides an overview of our proprietary and partnered commercial products and product opportunities:</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Corporate Information</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:5pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Antares is a Delaware corporation with principal executive offices located at 100 Princeton South Corporate Center, Suite 300, Ewing, New Jersey 08628.&#160;&#160;We have two wholly owned subsidiaries in Switzerland (Antares Pharma AG and Antares Pharma IPL AG).&#160;&#160;On January 31, 2001, we completed a business combination to acquire the operating subsidiaries of Permatec Holding AG, headquartered in Basel, Switzerland. Upon completion of the transaction, our name was changed from Medi Ject Corporation to Antares Pharma, Inc. We were incorporated as a Delaware corporation on April 29, 2005.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Segment and Geographic Information</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:5pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We have a single reportable operating segment, which encompasses all of our pharmaceutical products and technologies. See Note 2 and Note 14 to the Consolidated Financial Statements in <span style="font-weight:bold;">Part II, Item 8</span> about segment and geographic financial information.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Our Strategy and Market Opportunity</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Our strategy is to grow the business through targeted investments in internal and partnered product development and other corporate opportunities that leverage our patented drug delivery technology platforms, as well as our commercial infrastructure, primarily focused in certain therapeutic areas. We have built a robust commercial organization to market and sell our proprietary products and have significant experience in developing drug/device combination products and navigating the regulatory approval process.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">5</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Historically</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">,</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> our focus has been primarily on the market for delivery of self-administered injectable drugs. </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We seek</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> to identify development and commercialization opportunities</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">, both internally and through </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">partnered or </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">business development</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> opportunities</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">,</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> that </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">apply patented drug delivery technolog</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">ies</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> to new or existing approved drug formulations in order to enhance the drug delivery methods and provide commercial and/or functional advantages</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">,</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">such as improved safety and efficacy, reduced side effects, </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">convenience </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">and enhanced patient comfort and adherence</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">. </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In addition to self-administered injectable drugs, we have and continue to explore opportunities beyond </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">i</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">njectable</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> drugs that may complement our strategy and leverage our capabilities.</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> pursue these opportunities both on our own or with industry leading partners. We believe this strategy </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">offers a distinct value to patients, healthcare providers, pharmaceutical partners and our shareholders</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">. </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Injection is a common drug delivery pathway, and the delivery of pharmaceutical therapies through injection systems often improves the systemic bioavailability of those treatments by overcoming absorption barriers common with oral and, in some cases, transdermal delivery. Improved bioavailability is considered beneficial when evaluating the role of route of administration on pharmaceutical efficacy. We believe that our advanced injection technology platforms provide drug delivery solutions that can result in improved safety and efficacy, reduced side effects, and enhanced patient comfort and adherence.&#160;&#160;Many pharmaceutical companies focus on the development of important chronic care products and emergency rescue therapies that can be administered only by injection.&#160;&#160;We believe our advanced injection technologies uniquely address these market needs and are well suited for both the branded and generic marketplace.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We and our partners have historically sought, and are in the process of seeking, FDA approval for certain product candidates primarily using the 505(b)(2) NDA (New Drug Application) or ANDA (Abbreviated New Drug Application) approval pathways, as well as more recently the 505(b)(1) NDA pathway with certain partners, which are further described in the &#8220;Government Regulation&#8221; section below. Our technology platforms allow for device customization, which can provide multiple opportunities in both the 505(b)(2) NDA and generic market spaces, as well as the 505(b)(1) NDA pathway. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">According to a <span style="font-style:italic;">Market Research Engine</span> report, it is estimated that the global injectable drug delivery market will grow to $775&#160;billion by 2024, representing a compounded annual growth rate of 11.5% in the forecast period.&#160;&#160;This expected growth is attributable to several factors, including&#160;label expansion for approved products, increasing the patient pool for such products, a pipeline of injectable medications at various stages of clinical development, and the increasing incidence of certain diseases that will necessitate the utilization of injectable medications.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">See also &#8220;<span style="font-weight:bold;color:#000000;">Our Products&#8221; and &#8220;Research and Development&#8221; </span><span style="color:#000000;">below f</span>or additional discussion of market size and opportunities relative to the current therapeutic areas associated with our existing portfolio of products and products in development.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Our Competitive Strengths</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We believe our key competitive strengths are our commercial capabilities and infrastructure, proprietary injection technologies, and our ability to form significant strategic alliances with industry-leading pharmaceutical partners to develop and commercialize proprietary and partnered products. We also believe our management team has unique knowledge of, and experience in the drug/device combination product space and navigating the related regulatory approval process, which creates opportunities for us and potential pharmaceutical partners that look to us for our unique capabilities and know-how. Our business model for developing and commercializing proprietary and partnered products has been validated, we believe, by the successive FDA approvals of our NDAs for XYOSTED<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> and OTREXUP<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>and our ANDA for Sumatriptan Injection USP, as well as the FDA approval of Teva&#8217;s AB-rated generic version of the EpiPen<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Intellectual Property, Patents, Trade Secrets and Proprietary Information</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We strive to protect and enhance the proprietary technologies that we believe are important to our business and rely on know-how and continuing technological innovation to develop, strengthen, and maintain our competitive position. <span style="color:#000000;">When appropriate, we actively seek protection for our products and proprietary information by means of U.S. and international patents and trademarks.&#160;&#160;We currently hold a portfolio of patents with expirations ranging from 2021 to 2038, and numerous patent applications pending in the U.S. and other countries.&#160;&#160;</span>These patents consist primarily of design, formulation and method-of-use patents. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In addition to our patents and patent applications, t<span style="color:#000000;">rade secrets play an important role in protecting our products and technologies and provide protection beyond patents and regulatory exclusivity.</span>&#160;&#160;We strive to preserve the confidentiality of our trade secrets, proprietary know-how and inventions <span style="color:#000000;">by maintaining physical security of our sites and electronic security of our information technology systems.</span> We also require all employees, contractors and third-party consultants with access to proprietary information to execute confidentiality agreements prohibiting the disclosure of confidential information to anyone outside the Company. These agreements also require disclosure and assignment to us of discoveries and inventions made by such individuals while devoted to Company-sponsored activities. Partners with which we have entered into development agreements have the right to certain technology developed in connection with such agreements.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">6</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Human Capital</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We believe that our success is largely dependent upon our ability to attract and retain qualified employees. We currently have approximately 185 full-time employees, of which approximately 35 employees are based in our New Jersey corporate facility, 60 employees in our Minnesota operations and 90 field-based employees. Our workforce includes approximately 95 employees directly involved in or supporting our commercial sales organization, 20 in research and development, 40 in manufacturing and quality, and 30 in corporate and administrative functions. We are not party to any collective bargaining arrangements. Although we believe that the size of our current workforce is appropriate to achieve our objectives, we may hire additional employees with specialized expertise as we continue to grow our business. We believe that we have been successful to date in attracting skilled and experienced scientific and business professionals. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We continue to focus on building a high performing organization with an engaging work culture and have established initiatives to support this strategic priority. We perform bi-annual employee engagement surveys, set and monitor retention goals, and intend to invest in training and leadership development to cultivate our emerging leaders. Additionally, we are committed to diversity and inclusion as a core focus of our human capital strategy, and we are in the process of developing and implementing company-wide diversity and inclusion training. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We strongly believe that the success of Antares depends, in part, on open and regular communication with employees to help foster a high performing and engaged workforce.&#160;&#160;To help ensure that employees fully understand the Company&#8217;s long term strategy and annual goals and how their work contributes to the Company&#8217;s success we utilize a variety of channels to facilitate open and direct communication, including: (i)&#160;quarterly CEO Town Hall meetings&#59; (ii)&#160;regular ongoing update communications&#59; and (iii)&#160;employee engagement surveys.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company&#8217;s compensation philosophy is to pay for performance, support the Company&#8217;s business strategies, and offer competitive compensation arrangements to attract and retain key individuals and has established a Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors. Consistent with this philosophy, the Compensation Committee considers the impact of our corporate performance in determining compensation for named executive officers, as well as each named executive officer&#8217;s individual performance, macroeconomic conditions generally, and data from peer group companies.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Our Technology and Product Platforms</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Pressure assisted auto injection is a form of parenteral drug delivery that continues to gain acceptance and demand among the medical and patient community. Encompassing a wide variety of sizes and designs, our technology operates by using pressure to force the drug, in solution or suspension, through the skin and deposits the drug into the subcutaneous or intramuscular tissue. We have designed disposable, pressure assisted auto injector devices to address acute and chronic medical needs, such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis, allergic reactions, migraine headaches, testosterone deficiency and maternal health. Our current platforms include the VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>and<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top"> </sup>the VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> QuickShot<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>disposable pressure assisted auto injection systems and disposable pen injection systems.&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Auto Injectors</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Our proprietary VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> disposable auto injector systems combine a spring-based power source with a shielded needle, which delivers the needed drug solution subcutaneously or intramuscularly. In order to minimize the anxiety and perceived pain associated with injection-based technologies, the VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> system features a triggering collar that shields the needle from view. The patented retracting collar springs back and locks in place as a protective needle guard after the injection, making the device safe for general disposal. We believe the key competitive advantages of the VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> system include: reliable subcutaneous or intramuscular injection, designed to work with conventional pre-filled syringes, rapid injection with ability to deliver viscous solutions, ease of use in emergencies, and reduced pain.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The primary goal of the VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> disposable pressure assisted auto injector is to provide a fast, safe, and time-efficient method of self-injection. This device is designed around conventional single dose pre-filled syringes, which is a primary drug container, offering ease of transition for potential pharmaceutical partners.&#160;&#160;Our proprietary product OTREXUP<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> uses the VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> auto injector system for delivery of methotrexate. We also have two license agreements with Teva for our VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> system, one for Teva&#8217;s generic epinephrine auto injector and the other for our Sumatriptan Injection USP.&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> QuickShot<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>Auto Injectors<span style="font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;"> </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">An advancement of our proprietary line of VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> auto injectors is the VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> QuickShot<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> auto injector system, which offers a dose capacity of 1 mL or greater in a compact design. VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> QuickShot<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> is designed to enhance performance on the attributes we believe most critical to patient acceptance, which are speed, comfort and discretion. VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> QuickShot<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> achieves these advancements by incorporating a novel triggering mechanism and space-saving spring configuration. The unique design also </p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">7</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">accommodates fast injection of highly viscous drug products that less-powerful conventional auto injectors are typically unable to deliver.&#160;&#160;Many self-injectable drugs that are currently marketed or in clinical development are of higher viscosity and are formulated to be administered in a 1 mL dose volume. Our proprietary product </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">XYOSTED</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup></span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">, </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">and the Makena</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup></span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> subcutaneous auto injector that we developed with our partner AMAG</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">,</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">w</span><span style="font-family:Times New <p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Auto-Insert Injection Technology</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We have recently developed a new and versatile auto injector system to meet evolving market needs. The Auto-Insert device builds off the capabilities of our VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> platform adding automatic needle insertion, subcutaneous or intra-muscular (&#8220;IM&#8221;) injections of up to 1 inch and delivered volumes of up to 2 mL. This new device can accommodate 1 mL standard, 1 mL long, and 2.25 mL syringes. The auto-insert technology is intended to improve compliance for drug products requiring deep IM injections.&#160;&#160;This new device is easily convertible to different fill volumes and needle lengths and was designed specifically to meet the reliability requirements for emergency use applications while maintaining the simple and intuitive two-step process of administration of the VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> device.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Pen Injector System</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Our multi-dose, disposable pen injector technology complements our portfolio of single-use pressure assisted auto injector devices.&#160;&#160;The disposable pen injector device is designed to deliver drugs by injection through needles from multi-dose cartridges.&#160;&#160;Our disposable pen injector is designed for chronic conditions such as diabetes, which require daily injection of a product.&#160;&#160;Depending on dosage, our pens can deliver up to thirty days of drug.&#160;&#160;We have licensed our pen injector device technology to Teva for two potential products: a multi-dose pen with teriparatide for the treatment of osteoporosis (a generic form of Forteo<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>) and a multi-dose pen with exenatide for the treatment of diabetes (a generic version of BYETTA<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>).</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Our Products</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The following is a discussion of our approved and marketed commercial products, including proprietary and partnered products.&#160;&#160;For a discussion of other product candidates currently in development, see the &#8220;<span style="font-weight:bold;">Research and Development</span>&#8221; section below.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">XYOSTED<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (testosterone enanthate) injection<span style="text-decoration:underline;font-style:normal;"> </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">XYOSTED<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (testosterone enanthate) injection is our proprietary product for subcutaneous administration of testosterone replacement therapy (&#8220;TRT&#8221;) in adult males for conditions associated with a deficiency or absence of endogenous testosterone. XYOSTED<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, which is currently marketed and sold in the U.S., is the only FDA approved subcutaneous testosterone enanthate product for once-weekly, at-home self-administration and is approved and marketed in three dosage strengths, 50 mg, 75 mg and 100 mg. XYOSTED<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> provides an easy and virtually pain-free administration, low risk of transference and the ability to achieve and maintain steady levels of testosterone. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the U.S., there are several different formulations for TRT including intramuscular injection, topical and oral. According to IQVIA <span style="color:#2B3A42;">National Sales Perspectives<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (&#8220;NSP&#8221;) </span>reporting<span style="color:#2B3A42;"> of nationally projected sales activities, t</span>he overall U.S. TRT market was approximately $1.4 billion in 2020 based on wholesale acquisition costs (&#8220;WAC&#8221;). Total prescriptions in the U.S. TRT market grew by 6.8% to 7.6 million prescriptions in 2020 as compared to 2019, entirely driven by an increase in prescriptions of injectables, which increased by 7.3%. The injectable TRT market grew from $411.7 million in 2019 to $480.7 million in 2020, an increase of 16.8% based on WAC. As of December 2020, XYOSTED<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> commanded approximately 51% and 43% of the branded TRT market among Urologists and Endocrinologists, respectively. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Competition in the U.S. testosterone replacement market includes topical solutions such as Abbvie&#8217;s Androgel<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> and Androgel<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> 1.62%, Perrigo&#8217;s generic 1.62% testosterone topical gel, Lilly&#8217;s Axiron<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Endo&#8217;s Fortesta<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> and Testim<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>(and the authorized generic) and Allergan plc&#8217;s (&#8220;Allergan&#8221;) Androderm<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>. Other forms of TRT include injectables, such as Endo&#8217;s Aveed<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Pfizer&#8217;s Depo<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>-Testosterone, and several generic testosterones in oil products sold by Actavis, Sandoz, Mylan (now a part of Viatris Inc.), Teva and others, as well as Testopel<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>pellets by Endo. Clarus Therapeutics (&#8220;Clarus&#8221;) launched Jatenzo<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>,<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top"> </sup>an oral formulation of testosterone undecanoate, and Lipocine, Inc. (&#8220;Lipocine&#8221;) recently received tentative FDA approval for an oral formulation of testosterone undecanoate, Tlando<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>. </p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">OTREXUP</span><span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup></span><span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> (methotrexate) injection</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We market and sell in the U.S. our proprietary product OTREXUP<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (methotrexate) injection. OTREXUP<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> is a subcutaneous methotrexate injection for once weekly self-administration with an easy-to-use, single dose, disposable auto injector, indicated for adults with severe active rheumatoid arthritis (&#8220;RA&#8221;), children with active polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis and adults with severe recalcitrant psoriasis.&#160;&#160;We currently market seven dosage strengths of OTREXUP<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>in the U.S.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">According to the Arthritis Foundation, RA affects approximately 1.5 million Americans. Methotrexate is considered the first-line disease modifying anti-rheumatic drug (&#8220;DMARD&#8221;) prescribed to patients with RA according to the Johns Hopkins Arthritis Center.  Methotrexate is usually started at 12.5 mg, to 15 mg given orally, once-a-week, and titrated up for greater therapeutic effect, or until the patient incurs side effects.&#160;&#160;The maximum dose given is generally 25 mg per week (10, 2.5 mg tablets given in one dose).&#160;&#160;Studies have reported as many as 30% to 60% of patients experience gastrointestinal side effects with oral methotrexate, preventing further dose escalation or requiring discontinuation in some patients. Also, the extent of oral absorption of methotrexate varies considerably between patients. We believe that OTREXUP<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> offers physicians and patients an important alternative to oral methotrexate tablets and vials of the injectable form of the drug administered with a needle and syringe.  OTREXUP<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> provides physicians and patients a convenient, practical and virtually painless option for administering parenteral methotrexate as an alternative to proceeding directly from oral methotrexate to biologics.&#160;&#160;Additionally, OTREXUP<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> is a self-contained injection device designed to minimize accidental contact with methotrexate, a hazardous drug agent.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Medexus Pharma markets and sells Rasuvo<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, a once-weekly, subcutaneous, single-dose auto-injector of methotrexate indicated for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis and juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA), which is a direct competitor to OTREXUP<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>. Cumberland Pharmaceuticals, Inc. also recently received FDA approval and launched RediTrex&#174;, a methotrexate injection in the U.S.&#160;&#160;Competition in the methotrexate market also includes tablets and parenteral dosage forms that are distributed in the U.S. by several generic manufacturers, including Teva, Pfizer, Inc. (&#8220;Pfizer&#8221;), Viatris Inc. (&#8220;Viatris&#8221;), Hospira and Accord Healthcare. Beyond DMARDs, other commonly used pharmaceutical treatments for rheumatoid arthritis include analgesics, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), corticosteroids and biologic response modifiers.&#160;&#160;In addition to methotrexate, the other DMARDs include azathioprine (Imuran<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), cyclosporine (Neoral<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), hydroxychloroquine (Plaquenil<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), auranofin (Ridaura<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), leflunomide (Arava<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>) and sulfasalazine (Azulfidine<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>).&#160;&#160;The biologic response modifiers include etanercept (Enbrel<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), adalimumab (Humira<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), golimumab (Simponi<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), tocilizumab (Actemra<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), certolizumab (Cimzia<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), infliximab (Remicade<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), abatacept (Orencia<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), and rituximab (Rituxan<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>). </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">NOCDURNA<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (desmopressin acetate) Sublinqual Tablets</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We market and sell NOCDURNA<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (desmopressin acetate) in the United States, which is the first and only sublingual tablet indicated for the treatment of nocturia due to nocturnal polyuria (NP) in adults who awaken at least two times per night to urinate. NOCDURNA<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup><sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top"> </sup>is a sublingual tablet, marketed in two dosage strengths, that dissolves quickly under the tongue without water and has been shown in clinical studies to reduce nighttime urination by nearly half (in patients who average 3 nighttime bathroom visits.) We license NOCDURNA<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup><sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top"> </sup>from Ferring Pharmaceuticals.&#160;&#160;We began detailing NOCDURNA<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> in in the fourth quarter of 2020 and are currently in the process of re-launching the product with a comprehensive strategy to increase awareness and demand.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">It is estimated that more than 40 million people in the U.S. are affected by nocturia, or frequent waking at night to urinate.&#160;&#160;Of the approximately 10 million patients diagnosed with nocturia, only about 1.5 million are treated for the condition. One of the leading causes of nocturia is nocturnal polyuria, which is present in up to 88% of nocturia patients. In patients diagnosed with nocturnal polyuria, the kidneys produce too much urine at night. Patients may already be taking medication for overactive bladder (OAB) or benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH)&#59; however, these medications may not reduce night-time urination because they do not treat NP. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Pharmacological therapy is most useful in treating nocturia due to nocturnal polyuria, including desmopressin, an anti-diuretic hormone therapy. The antidiuretic effects of desmopressin are mediated by stimulation of vasopressin 2 (V2) receptors, thereby increasing water re-absorption in the kidney, and hence reducing urine production. Desmopressin is available as both an oral tablet and a nasal spray. Noctiva&#8482;, an FDA-approved nasal formulation of desmopressin acetate, although not currently marketed in the U.S., is the only other FDA-approved branded desmopressin acetate indicated for the treatment of nocturia. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Epinephrine Injection USP</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We developed and are the exclusive supplier of the device for Teva&#8217;s generic Epinephrine Injection USP products, indicated for emergency treatment of severe allergic reactions including those that are life threatening (anaphylaxis) in adults and certain pediatric patients. Teva&#8217;s Epinephrine Injection, utilizing our patented VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> injection technology, was approved by the FDA in August 2018 as a generic drug product with an AB rating, meaning that it is therapeutically equivalent to the branded products EpiPen<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> and EpiPen Jr<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> and therefore, subject to state law, substitutable at the pharmacy. Teva announced a limited commercial launch of its generic epinephrine product in late fourth quarter of 2018 with full commercial availability in 2019. We supply the device and Teva is responsible for the drug, assembly and packaging, distribution and commercialization of the finished product, for which we also receive royalties on Teva&#8217;s net sales. </p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">9</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Epinephrine is utilized for the treatment of severe allergic reactions (anaphylaxis) to insect venom, foods, drugs and other allergens as well as anaphylaxis to unknown substances or exercise-induced anaphylaxis. </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Viatris</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#8217;s EpiPen</span><span style="font-family:Times New There are other companies and alternative products competing in the mark</span><span style="font-family:Times New February 2017, and </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Adamis Pharmaceutic</span><span Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">. </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Sumatriptan Injection USP</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We, through our partner Teva, sell Sumatriptan Injection USP, indicated in the U.S. for the acute treatment of migraine headaches and cluster headache in adults.&#160;&#160;Sumatriptan Injection USP is a generic equivalent to Imitrex<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> STATdose Pen<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, and available in the 4 mg/0.5 mL and 6 mg/0.5 mL single-dose prefilled syringe auto-injectors.&#160;&#160;We have a license, supply and distribution agreement with Teva, under which Teva is responsible for the manufacture and supply of the drug, and we manufacture the device and complete assembly and packaging of the finished product. Teva is responsible for commercialization and distribution.&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The total U.S. retail anti-migraine triptan market was $4.5 billion in 2020 according to IQVIA&#8217;s <span style="color:#2B3A42;">National Prescription Audit<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (&#8220;</span>NPA&#8221;) report based on TRx Pharmacy Dollars. The majority of patients who use triptans take oral tablets.&#160;&#160;Oral drugs accounted for $4.1 billion of the total, and injectable products accounted for approximately $264 million of the total market, measured in terms of TRx Pharmacy Dollars. Sumatriptan is currently available in an oral formulation, a nasal spray (Imitrex, GSK and generic) and a needleless injector (Sumavel, Astellas/Zogenix). There is extensive competition in the sumatriptan marketplace and several manufacturers offer versions of injectable sumatriptan with a delivery device, including GSK (Imitrex STATdose Pen<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), Teva (AJOVY<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>), Pfizer (Alsuma), ENDO Pharmaceuticals (Sumavel DosePro), Sun Pharma (generic sumatriptan autoinjector) and Upsher-Smith (Zembrace SymTouch). One company, Sandoz, Inc. (&#8220;Sandoz&#8221;) markets an authorized generic version of GSK&#8217;s Imitrex STATdose Pen<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Makena<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (hydroxyprogesterone caproate injection) Subcutaneous Auto Injector</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We developed a variation of our VIBEX<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> QuickShot<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> subcutaneous auto injector for use with AMAG&#8217;s progestin hormone drug Makena<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (hydroxyprogesterone caproate injection) under an exclusive license and development agreement. The Makena<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> subcutaneous auto injector drug-device combination product is a ready-to-administer treatment indicated to reduce the risk of preterm birth in women pregnant with one baby and who spontaneously delivered one preterm baby in the past. The product was approved by the FDA in February 2018. We are the exclusive supplier of the devices and the final assembled and packaged commercial product to AMAG. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Makena<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>is a <span style="color:#000000;">progestin that belongs to a class of drugs called progestogens. Progestogens have been studied to reduce preterm birth and have shown varying results depending upon the subjects enrolled. </span>The active ingredient in Makena<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, 17&#945; hydroxyprogesterone caproate (often referred to as 17P), is the only FDA-approved treatment for pregnant women who have had a prior spontaneous preterm birth (which is a substantial risk factor for recurrent preterm birth) and has been and used for more than a decade by healthcare providers to treat patients with a history of spontaneous preterm birth.<span style="color:#000000;"> </span>The approval of Makena<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> was based on the landmark Meis trial, conducted by the National Institute of Child Health and Human Development and the Maternal-Fetal Medicine Units Network and published in the New England Journal of Medicine in 2003. <span style="color:#000000;">The Society for Maternal Fetal Medicine Publications Committee published&#160;clinical guidelines&#160;for the use of progestogens to reduce the risk of preterm birth in the American Journal of Obstetrics and Gynecology in May 2012, which were affirmed in 2014. Preterm birth is defined as a birth prior to 37&#160;weeks of pregnancy. According to the March of Dimes, preterm births affected nearly 380,000 babies, or one of every ten infants born in the United States.</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In October 2019, AMAG announced that the FDA&#8217;s Bone, Reproductive and Urologic Drugs Advisory Committee met to better understand and interpret the PROLONG (Progestin&#8217;s Role in Optimizing Neonatal Gestation) confirmatory clinical trial for Makena<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (hydroxyprogesterone caproate) injection. Nine advisory committee members voted to recommend that the FDA pursue withdrawal of approval for Makena<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> and seven committee members voted to leave the product on the market under accelerated approval and require a new confirmatory trial. In October 2020, AMAG received notice that the FDA is proposing to withdraw approval of Makena<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (hydroxyprogesterone caproate injection). AMAG requested a public hearing in response to the FDA&#8217;s proposal to withdraw its approval and has stated that it remains committed to working with the FDA to maintain patient access to Makena<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> as a treatment option to reduce pre-term birth. In November 2020, Covis Group, a private pharmaceutical company focused on providing therapeutic solutions for patients with life-threatening conditions and chronic illnesses, acquired AMAG.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">10</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Teriparatide Injection</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We developed and are the exclusive supplier of the multi-dose pen utilized in Teva&#8217;s generic teriparatide injection product. In 2020, our partner Teva launched Teriparatide Injection, the generic version of Eli Lilly&#8217;s branded product Forsteo<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> featuring the Antares multi-dose pen platform, for commercial sale in several countries outside of the United States. Under an exclusive development, license and supply agreement with Teva, Antares is responsible for the manufacturing and supply of the multi-dose pen utilized in Teva&#8217;s generic teriparatide product and Teva is responsible for the sale and distribution of the product. Antares is compensated for devices sold to Teva and is entitled to receive royalties on net product sales by Teva in the territories.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Teriparatide is used for the treatment of osteoporosis in postmenopausal women and men at increased risk of fracture and for glucocorticoid induced osteoporosis in men and women. According to Eli Lilly&#8217;s annual report, 2020 global sales of Forteo<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> was $1.05 billion, of which $510.3 million was recorded in the U.S. and $536.0 million in the rest of the world.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Research and Development</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We are committed to a strong research and development program, recognizing that the development of new product offerings is important to our future success. <span style="Background-color:#FFFFFF;">An important part of our growth strategy is our continued investment in our evolving research and development activities and new product pipeline. While we are focused on opportunities within urology and endocrinology therapeutic areas, we are also exploring new product opportunities beyond these therapeutic areas that could further grow and diversify our portfolio. </span>Our research and development efforts are focused primarily on leveraging our existing product and technology platforms by broadening their applications for use in other drug/device combination products, as well as exploring new pharmaceutical products, technologies and drug delivery methods. We also have a corporate development team that actively seeks and evaluates new business and product opportunities to further expand our pipeline.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Our research and development programs consist primarily<span style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;color:#000000;"> of clinical, regulatory, formulation development, engineering and device development activities for our current products</span>, next generation versions of current products, product extensions, and new proprietary and partnered products and technologies in development<span style="letter-spacing:0.1pt;color:#000000;">. </span>Our internal research and development team works with external consultants, industry experts, physicians and other medical personnel in an effort to drive our product development pipeline. The following is a discussion of our significant research and development activities.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">ATRS - 1901</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In 2019, we initiated development of a proprietary drug device combination product for the urology oncology market, identified as ATRS-1901. We have conducted formulation development work and non-clinical studies to help advance this program. In 2020, we received a response from the FDA regarding our pre-IND (Investigational New Drug) submission and believe we have determined our clinical and regulatory pathway forward.&#160;&#160;We expect to file an IND for this program with the FDA in the second half of 2021. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">ATRS -1902</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In 2019, we identified a program to develop a proprietary drug device combination product for the endocrinology market, identified as ATRS-1902.&#160;&#160;We conducted initial formulation work and developed a working prototype of a new device to support this program. We received a response from the FDA regarding our pre-IND submission and believe we have determined the regulatory and clinical path forward. We expect to file an IND for this program with the FDA in the first half of 2021.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;Background-color:#FFFFFF;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Additional Development Programs</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We continue to pursue and evaluate other potential new products and product extensions that address patient needs primarily in our targeted therapeutic areas. <span style="Background-color:#FFFFFF;">We actively explore new options for patients including innovative delivery technologies and improved formulations of existing therapeutics.</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;Background-color:#FFFFFF;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:inherit;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> <span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;">Partnered Development Projects </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We, in collaboration with our pharmaceutical partners, are engaged in research and development activities utilizing our auto injectors and disposable pen injectors. The development programs typically consist of determination of the device design, development of prototype tooling, production of prototype devices for testing and clinical studies, and development of commercial tooling and assembly. We expect development related to these products to continue&#59; however, the development timelines are generally controlled by our partners and the extent of near-term and future development will be dependent on decisions made by our partners. The following is a summary of the development stages for each of the partnered products in development:</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">11</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;Background-color:#FFFFFF;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Pen Injector with Teriparatide</span><span style="text-decoration:underline;"> </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We are developing with Teva, under a license, development and supply agreement, a multi-dose disposable pen injector device with teriparatide for the treatment of osteoporosis. Teva is actively working toward a regulatory approval with the FDA for a generic version of Forteo<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (teriparatide [rDNA origin] injection) using the ANDA pathway and has indicated it is awaiting a potential FDA approval in 2021. See also the &#8220;Teriparatide Injection&#8221; section above for more information about the product and Teva&#8217;s commercialization activities outside the United States.&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;Background-color:#FFFFFF;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Pen Injector with Exenatide</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We are also developing with Teva a multi-dose pen injector device for use with a generic form of BYETTA<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (exenatide injection) for the treatment of diabetes.&#160;&#160;Teva is working through the U.S. regulatory approval process for its exenatide pen using the ANDA pathway. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Exenatide, marketed as BYETTA<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, is used along with diet and exercise to treat type 2 diabetes, a condition in which the body does not use insulin normally and therefore cannot control the amount of sugar in the blood. &#160;Exenatide works by stimulating the pancreas to secrete insulin when blood sugar levels are high. Insulin helps move sugar from the blood into other body tissues where it is used for energy. Exenatide also slows the emptying of the stomach and causes a decrease in appetite. Exenatide is not used to treat type 1 diabetes, a condition in which the body does not produce insulin and therefore cannot control the amount of sugar in the blood. &#160;Exenatide is not used instead of insulin to treat people with diabetes who need insulin.&#160; Total gross U.S. sales of BYETTA<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (exenatide) by AstraZeneca&#160;in 2020 were approximately $135 million according to IQVIA NSP. BYDUREON<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, a long-acting form of the medication BYETTA<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, had approximately $1.2 billion in gross sales in the U.S. in 2020 based on WAC, according to IQVIA NSP.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Rescue Pen (drug undisclosed)</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In August 2018, we entered into a development<span style="margin-left:36pt;"></span> agreement with Pfizer and began developing a combination drug device rescue pen. This rescue pen will utilize the Antares QuickShot<sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> auto injector and an undisclosed Pfizer drug. We will develop the product and Pfizer will be responsible for obtaining FDA approval of the combination product. We entered into a separate commercial supply agreement with Pfizer pursuant to which we will sell fully packaged commercial ready finished product to Pfizer, assuming FDA approval. Pfizer will be responsible for commercializing the product in the U.S., and we will receive royalties on net sales.&#160;&#160;We have begun design work, feasibility testing and Human Factor studies.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Rescue Device with Selatogrel</span></p>
